subject: E-Commerce
title: Why 70% Abandon Carts
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why 70% Abandon Carts.

hook.text: 7 out of 10 online shoppers add items to their cart and never buy. That's $4 trillion in abandoned merchandise yearly.

buildup.text: The top reason: unexpected costs. Shipping fees, taxes, and handling charges surprise shoppers at checkout.

discovery.text: Other causes: forced account creation (24%), slow delivery (18%), and a too-complex checkout process (17%).

twist.text: Many shoppers use the cart as a wish list. They never intended to buy—just browsing and bookmarking.

climax.text: Cart abandonment is the biggest revenue leak in e-commerce. Fixing it is worth trillions.

punchline.text: $4 trillion abandoned yearly. Surprising fees at checkout destroy the deal.

quiz.question: What is the number one reason for cart abandonment?
options: Unexpected costs like shipping fees at checkout
